detail.longDescription: Jocelyne (Joce) Mendez-Guzman is no stranger to the Zappy Awards. In 2025, she won our Operations Automator of the Year for a workflow that processed accounts receivable tickets 69% faster. With that win under her belt, she moved into BioRender's RevOps team, where her work now supports teammates across GTM.
